The provider only accepts one hundred invoices per minute, but last night there were forty-two hundred, so forty-one hundred failed and weren't sent. You can re-run the job now with the quick fix, do the proper bulk fix, or leave it for now.
It worked until now because the nightly count was always under the limit. The new annual plans pushed the volume to forty-two hundred, which caused the overflow.
